note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes and BOL numbers exist for outbound cargo from Nhava Sheva and Hazira to the UK (HS 27121090, petroleum jelly, BOL 9899906, 2026-02-21) and to Mozambique (HS 34024200, ceteareth 20, BOL 9823791, 2026-02-19), plus buyer-side lanes to USA, UK, Morocco and Pakistan. Declared HS 271210 is corroborated by the 27121090 export record; declared 271220 and 291639 were not observed in the visible rows, and the observed export HS 34024200 is outside the declared set — per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the actual code should simply be recorded. Note the company is also a large importer of base oil (HS 27101971) from Trafigura, Tenoit, SK Enmove, GS Caltex, Hywax — i.e. it is a real operating blender/manufacturer, not a paper trader. Caveat on counters: ImportKey advertises 573 and 130 shipments across two address variants, but only 5 rows per table are visible in the free view, so the counters are unverified beyond the rows quoted. Domestic India supply (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search returned a backend connection error on both attempts, and thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown with null evidence rather than inferred from the website or catalogues. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the sources read — left null, not estimated.
